text:
Predicates:
Created(x, y) ::: x created y.
Game(y) ::: y is a game.
JapaneseCompany(x) ::: x is a Japanese game company.
OnTop10(y) ::: y is on the Top 10 list.
SoldMoreThanOneMillion(y) ::: y sold more than one million copies.
Premises:
Created(gameCompany, theLegendOfZelda) ::: A Japanese game company created the Legend of Zelda.
∀y (OnTop10(y) → ∃x (Game(x) ∧ MadeBy(x, y))) ::: All games on the Top 10 list are made by Japanese game companies.
∀y (SoldMoreThanOneMillion(y) → OnTop10(y)) ::: If a game sells more than one million copies, then it will be included in the Top 10 list.
SoldMoreThanOneMillion(theLegendOfZelda) ::: The Legend of Zelda sold more than one million copies.
Conclusion:
OnTop10(theLegendOfZelda) ::: The Legend of Zelda is on the Top 10 list.
